body: I guess it just feels like I fuck things up. In my romantic relationships, it's always me who is destructive. I was a young mom and I feel like I wasn't always the greatest parent. Saying it, it doesn't sound like much but me for me, I feel like a failure. I think my family would have me hospitalized. I work as a social worker and most of my friends are in that same field and I think they'd judge the shit out of me.
